posts.en:
dsh-github is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Official-grade GitHub CI integration: a composite action.yml, a polling PR review bot with idempotent inline comments and a status-check gate, plus PR/issues tools with every write gated by human approval.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-3a4c94f1b1a1f4b3f042.html
